name: Carry five kilograms for twenty metres
short_description: Carry five kilograms for twenty metres once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can carry five kilograms for twenty metres in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Carry five kilograms for twenty metres means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Carry five kilograms for twenty metres in a fresh real-life scenario.
